title: Detour Fare Corrections on Unpaid Wayfare Rides Fares
content:
## Rule

On **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** a trip whose fare charge was recalculated because the actual miles or minutes ran beyond the estimate while the rider changed nothing about the route was lengthened by the driver, and the rider owes only the honoured quote.

On a collected fare, a route-inefficiency fare adjustment still takes back the fare charge amount less the upfront fare less the member discount recorded on the fare charge; on a fare charge that failed to collect, the detour fare correction is owed instead.

A detour fare correction owed on a fare charge that failed to collect is booked only as a refund-offset settlement entry against that fare charge, giving route inefficiency as its reason, for the detour fare correction itself; no fare adjustment entry is written, the entry counts toward the trip's support limit in place of the fare adjustment it replaces, and the rest of the unpaid fare stays unpaid.

A detour fare correction that would take the support total of the trip above the ride option's support limit is sent to the fare review team as a fare review instead of being booked.

A trip whose rider changed the route, or whose fare stood at the upfront fare, gets no detour fare correction.

## Outcomes by the state of the fare

| Recalculated fare, no rider route change | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Fare charge collected | a route-inefficiency fare adjustment, taking back the fare charge amount less the upfront fare less the member discount recorded on the fare charge |
| Fare charge failed to collect; correction keeps the trip's support total within the support limit | the detour fare correction, booked as a refund-offset settlement entry against the unpaid fare charge, reason route inefficiency; the rest of the unpaid fare stays unpaid |
| Fare charge failed to collect; correction would take the trip's support total above the support limit | sent to the fare review team as a fare review instead of being booked |

| Other trips | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Rider changed the route | no detour fare correction |
| Fare stood at the upfront fare | no detour fare correction |

## Booking the correction — `book_detour_fare_offset_50a7c54a`

**Capability.** Books a detour fare correction against a rider's unpaid fare: it reduces what a rider owes on a fare charge that failed to collect, because the driver lengthened the trip. One call writes one settlement entry of the refund-offset kind against that unpaid fare charge, dated today, with the reason route inefficiency, for the amount given. The trip's unpaid amount and its net amount charged both drop by that amount, and no money moves to or from the rider's card. The rider sees the unpaid balance of the trip go down.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `book_detour_fare_offset_50a7c54a` with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trip_id` | the trip reference number of the detoured trip, as returned by the trip lookup | identifier |
| `original_charge_id` | the charge reference number of the unpaid fare charge being corrected, as returned by the trip charge lookup | identifier |
| `offset_amount` | the correction applied against the unpaid fare | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; the entry records it as a negative movement on the unpaid balance |

**Return.** A receipt with `trip_charge_id` (reference number of the new settlement entry), `trip_id`, `original_charge_id` (the unpaid fare charge), `amount` (signed entry amount in USD, negative, 2 decimal places), `outstanding_amount` (the trip's unpaid amount after the entry, USD, 2 decimal places), `net_charged` (the trip's net amount charged after the entry, USD, 2 decimal places) and `status`. A status of "booked" means the entry exists.
